text:
Nora K.: quick flag from onboarding: node SDK + batching helper caused a missing vector during a transient retry. python sample had all inputs mapped.

Yuki T.: can you share the smallest repro and the raw http order? curious if it's index vs id mapping.

Nora K.: repro (sanitized):
```js
// node sample
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-lite-v2',
  input: ['one','two','three','four','five'],
  batch_helper: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 3}
})
```
server sequence: POST sub-batch1 -> 200, POST sub-batch2 -> 502, retry sub-batch2 -> 200. final node array has 4 vectors, python has 5.

Sam W.: what's the stitch method in node right now? offsets or per-item ids?

DevEx-Engineer: node uses positional concat to minimize per-item overhead. python tags items with per-item uuids. when replay returns different length (server deduped replayed items) positional merge can drop entries.

Nora K.: ok that matches what i see. any quick workaround i can give the customer? they use node in prod.

DevEx-Engineer: short-term options:
- set `batch_helper.tag_ids=true` in node (adds small tags so replay can be reconciled)
- disable `batch_helper` entirely if latency/throughput tradeoffs are acceptable
- add header `X-Embed-Response: object_items` to get object shaped items from server (slower but explicit mapping)

Yuki T.: long-term proposal: 1) auto-enable a lightweight tag (we call it `compact_id`, 4-8 bytes) when retry/backoff is non-zero; 2) server emits `meta.dedupe_count` and `meta.sub_batch_ids` so clients can detect trimming; 3) new opt-in response shape header `X-Response-Shape: object_items` returning `[{embedding, input, compact_id}]`.

Sam W.: compact_id sounds nice  small bytes, deterministic mapping. any risk of collisions?

DevEx-Engineer: we can namespace compact_ids per-request with a short sequence (request_ts + 16-bit seq) to be collision-resistant for practical loads. it's much smaller than UUIDs and keeps wire perf.

Nora K.: can infra expose a switch to log when dedupe_count>0 so customers see it in traces? that would help root-cause during onboarding.

ops-bot: Created DEVEX-5123: "node batching: auto-compact-id when retry/backoff configured; server dedupe_count & sub_batch_ids; opt-in object_items response shape"  https://rwd.in/DEVEX-5123

Yuki T.: also adding a docs blurb for quickstart: explain `batch_helper.tag_ids`, `compact_id`, and when to use `X-Response-Shape`. short snippet + warning about auth refresh causing replays.

Sam W.: one more thought: server could accept a `client_seq` per item and echo a `position_map` in meta mapping original client_seq -> returned index. that avoids changing array shape but still allows mapping. downside is added meta payload.

DevEx-Engineer: yes `position_map` is an alternative. we'll prototype both: `compact_id` + `position_map` and benchmark wire overhead. add tests to reproduce transient 401/502 replay path.

Nora K.: thanks all. i'll push a minimal repro (node+python) into DEVEX-5123 and ping CRO onboarding. will use `batch_helper.tag_ids=true` as temporary fix. :thumbsup:

Yuki T.: sweet. follow-up: after ticket, we should add a tiny CLI fuzz test that simulates sub-batch errors so SDKs don't regress.

DevEx-Engineer: noted. adding to DEVEX-5123 checklist.

Nora K.: filing repro now.
